nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 liquidity asset held in escrow by the FundingLocker
Immutable address of the Loan contract authorized to pull and drain funds
Constructor that assigns the liquidityAsset and loan immutables
External isLoan-guarded function that transfers amt of liquidity asset to dst
External isLoan-guarded function that transfers the entire token balance to the loan
Modifier requiring msg.sender == loan before executing the guarded function
Caller address compared against the loan state variable in the isLoan modifier
External token transfer inside pull that performs a low-level call to the token contract with attacker-influenced dst
External token transfer inside drain that performs a low-level call to the token contract using the live contract balance
Destination address parameter of pull that receives the liquidity asset
Amount parameter of pull specifying how many liquidity asset tokens to transfer
Local variable holding liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)) read during drain

edges.reason: Constructor writes the liquidityAsset immutable from the _liquidityAsset argument
Constructor writes the loan immutable from the _loan argument
msg.sender is the untrusted value compared against loan inside the isLoan modifier
The loan state variable is the trusted side of the equality check in isLoan
The isLoan modifier gates entry into pull, restricting callers to the Loan contract
The isLoan modifier gates entry into drain, restricting callers to the Loan contract
pull executes the safeTransfer unsafe operation on the liquidity asset
The dst parameter flows directly into safeTransfer as the recipient
The amt parameter flows directly into safeTransfer as the transferred amount
liquidityAsset is the token contract on which the external transfer is performed
drain executes the safeTransfer unsafe operation on the liquidity asset
The local amt read from balanceOf flows into safeTransfer as the transferred amount
liquidityAsset is the token contract on which the external transfer is performed
The loan address is used as the recipient of the drained funds
The external token transfer in drain hands control to another contract before the function returns, allowing a malicious token or loan to reenter drain and re-read balanceOf
The external token transfer in pull transfers control to the token contract, which may reenter pull or other guarded entry points if state is not settled first

normalization_plan.reason: dst is a pull-only parameter whose sole use is as the recipient argument of safeTransfer, so it folds into the pull function node
amt in pull is a non-core parameter used only as the amount argument for the pull transfer and merges into the pull function node
The local amt in drain is a transient balance read used only by the drain transfer and merges into the drain function node
